slides.title: Past continuous
slides.subtitle: Pasado continuo y while / when
goals: Describir una acción en progreso en el pasado.
Combinarlo con el pasado simple usando **when** y **while**.

slides.title: Forma y uso
list: Acción en progreso en un momento del pasado: *At 8 o'clock I was having dinner.*
Acción larga interrumpida por una corta: *I **was cooking** when the phone **rang**.*
Dos acciones largas al mismo tiempo: ***While** I was studying, my brother was playing.*
slides.tip: **when** + acción corta (pasado simple) · **while** + acción larga (pasado continuo).

items.en: I was walking home when it started to rain.
items.es: Iba caminando a casa cuando empezó a llover.

items.en: What were you doing at 10 last night?
While she was driving, she was listening to music.
We weren't watching TV. We were talking.
items.es: No veíamos la tele. Estábamos platicando.

items.t: What ___ you doing when the lights went out?

items.q: I saw a friend ___ I was waiting for the bus.
He was taking a shower ___ the water stopped.
___ we were eating, it started to rain.

items.a: I was reading when you arrived.
What were you doing at midnight?
